summary: Long video to shorts: your long video (you, talking to the camera) in, several vertical shorts out, its key moments reorganised with the hook first, your real voice (and your cloned voice for a missing line, if you add an ElevenLabs key), Dynamic text with the long video's pictures; one music, -14 LUFS, checked.

prerequisites.label: Swift compiler (finding your face, cutting you out: Apple Vision)
Speech-to-text (Whisper, on your Mac's GPU)
prerequisites.hint: Installed on the first video by the video engine's bootstrap (plugins/video/skills/short-editor/scripts/bootstrap.mjs): it hears your take on this Mac, free, nothing sent.

prerequisites.label: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (your cloned voice, for a line you never said)
prerequisites.hint: Optional: in the app, Settings › Connectors › Add key. Your long video is heard on your Mac (Whisper, free); the key only lets your cloned voice say a short line the take does not have (a hook, a bridge), with a plan that allows Instant Voice Cloning (Starter or above). A voice line is about 60 characters. With a key, Scribe can hear the take instead if you ask.
prerequisites.does: Says a missing line (a hook, a bridge) in your cloned voice. Your long video is heard on your Mac, without it.
prerequisites.without: Your shorts are made from the lines you really said, with no AI voice.
prerequisites.cost: Billed by ElevenLabs: a voice line is about 60 characters. Your cloned voice needs the Starter plan or above.

prerequisites.label: GEMINI_API_KEY (the mood stickers of the hook, Nano Banana 2)
prerequisites.hint: About $0.07 a sticker (1K), billed by Google. Without one, the hook's mood pictures are the real icons of the tools you name, or left out.
prerequisites.does: Makes the few stickers that set the mood of the hook (an empty mail tray, a dartboard…), Nano Banana 2.
prerequisites.without: No sticker made: the hook keeps the real icons of the tools you name, or none.
prerequisites.cost: About $0.07 a sticker, four to six a subject, billed by Google.

prerequisites.label: GIPHY_API_KEY (searching the GIFs)
prerequisites.hint: Free at developers.giphy.com. Without it, a GIF comes from a giphy.com link given by hand. GIPHY grants no commercial licence: organic use only.
prerequisites.does: Searches the GIFs pinned as prints in your shorts.
prerequisites.without: No GIF search: a GIF only from a giphy.com link you give.
prerequisites.cost: Free (developers.giphy.com). GIFs are for organic posts only.

prerequisites.label: PEXELS_API_KEY (searching Pexels' stock videos)
prerequisites.hint: Free at pexels.com/api. Without it, Mixkit's free clips are searched (no key) and a Pexels video page given by hand is fetched through its own free-download link.
prerequisites.does: Searches Pexels' stock videos for the pictures on your words.
prerequisites.without: Mixkit's free clips only (no key needed), or a Pexels page you give.

prerequisites.label: The motion kit (fonts, Chrome, the Mac's tools)
prerequisites.hint: Set up on the first video by node plugins/video/motion/bootstrap.mjs (fonts, a headless Chrome if there is none, the Swift tools).

prerequisites.label: Music shelf (Mixkit)
prerequisites.hint: Downloaded from mixkit.co on the first video.
